## What this repository is

This repository is **output, not hand-written code**. The
[architekton-py](https://github.com/politeuma/architekton-py) template's CI
re-renders it on every push to the template's `main` branch from
[`example-answers.yml`](https://github.com/politeuma/architekton-py/blob/main/example-answers.yml)
and publishes the result here, so what you see is exactly what
`copier copy` produces for those answers at the template commit recorded in
[`.copier-answers.yml`](.copier-answers.yml) (`_commit`). Do not open pull
requests against the generated files: changes belong in the template, and the
next regeneration overwrites this repository.

Use it to:

- browse a real rendered project before you answer the template's questions;
- see the CI, docs site and agent guide ([AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)) the template
  ships, running against real code;
- diff two template versions by comparing this repository's history.

## Which kind it shows

architekton-py's `project_type` is a single choice (`library`, `web_api`,
`cli`, `data_science`, `online_judge`, `script`, `ros2`, `micropython`), and
each kind lays out a different project. This example is **one kind,
`data_science`**, not every option at once. With the answers in
[`.copier-answers.yml`](.copier-answers.yml) it includes:

| Area | What was rendered |
|:-----|:------------------|
| Layout | `src/architekton_py_example/` package beside the `data/`, `features/`, `models/`, `visualization/` pipeline stubs |
| Toolchain | uv, Task (`Taskfile.yml`), ruff, pytest, basedpyright + pyrefly, deptry, vulture, typos |
| Docs | Zensical site published to [GitHub Pages](https://politeuma.github.io/architekton-py-example) |
| Research | Quarto paper ([paper/paper.qmd](paper/paper.qmd)) and slide deck ([slides/slides.qmd](slides/slides.qmd)) |
| Containers | `Dockerfile` and a GPU `Dockerfile.gpu` |
| CI | GitHub Actions: lint, type-check, tests on Python 3.11–3.14, docs, repo hygiene, security, licence check |
| Project files | [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff), [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), [REUSE.toml](REUSE.toml), [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) with field rules |

To see another kind, render it yourself with the matching preset
(`architekton-py new <name> --preset <preset>`; see the
[template documentation](https://politeuma.github.io/architekton-py/)).

## Try it

The package is not published to PyPI. Install it from this repository:

```sh
pip install git+https://github.com/politeuma/architekton-py-example.git
python -m architekton_py_example --version
```

Or clone it and run the same checks CI runs (needs Python 3.11+,
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and [Task](https://taskfile.dev)):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/politeuma/architekton-py-example.git
cd architekton-py-example
uv sync
task check          # lint + type-check + tests
task docs           # build the documentation site
```

## Reproduce it

Render the same project from the template with the example answers:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/politeuma/architekton-py.git
uvx copier copy --trust --defaults \
    --data-file architekton-py/example-answers.yml \
    architekton-py my-example
```
